gloss: to come across, to run into, to encounter

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {出|で}くわしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to come across, to run into
definitions.explanation: To meet someone or encounter something unexpectedly and by chance.
To find oneself in an unexpected situation, often unpleasant.

⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出|で}くわした。
examples.english: I ran into my teacher at the station.

notes:
{出|で}くわす is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to encounter unexpectedly.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to go out) + ⟦くわす→くわす：noentry⟧ (to encounter) → to go out and encounter

ASPECT (ている):
{出|で}くわしている is rare; the simple past {出|で}くわした is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧{出|で}くわす (come across by chance)
- ～に{出|で}くわす (run into~)
- ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧に{出|で}くわす (encounter trouble)
- ⟦{思|おも}いがけず→思いがけず：07152_omoigakezu⟧{出|で}くわす (unexpectedly run into)

USAGE:
Implies an unexpected, unplanned encounter. Can be used for both pleasant surprises and awkward situations. More casual than ⟦{遭遇|そうぐう}→遭遇：14384_souguu⟧する.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出会|であ}う→出会う：02298_deau⟧: to meet, encounter (more neutral or positive)
- ⟦{遭遇|そうぐう}→遭遇：14384_souguu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to encounter (formal)
- {出|で}くわす often implies surprise or coincidence
